title: Two Sources
goal: The result must live past the inner block. Pick an argument that lives long enough.
hints: result escapes the block, so 'a must cover code past the block - but string2 dies inside it.
One of the choices lives forever. Literally.
explanation: The call's 'a becomes the intersection of both arguments' lifetimes, and result demands that 'a reach past the block - string2 can't (E0597), and cloning makes it worse: the temporary dies at the very same line (E0716). The literal "xyz" is &'static str, so the intersection collapses to string1's comfortable lifetime and result lives. This is rustlings' famous lifetimes2 - the fix isn't annotating harder, it's feeding the call data that lives long enough.
